title: Started rusting after 2nd washing - don't wash in a dishwasher
text: Started rusting after 2nd washing - don't wash in a dishwasher. Wash these by hand and dry immediately or you'll get rust after 1-2 uses.  Not particularly sharp.  They are very comfortable to hold. but I need ateak knife that actually cuts steak well.  I'll get by with these but I'm not impressed.
